summary: A Felucca-based drum machine firmware with eight drum tracks, a step sequencer and per-track effects, played entirely from the FM-1's own panel.
features: Eight tracks of 808, 909, Plaits-derived and sample drum models
Up to 64 steps per track with probability, ratchets, nudge and motion
"ACID" 303-style bass voice on up to two tracks
Grids pattern generator and a sidechain compressor for pumping
Live PERFORM effects, MIDI Learn and USB audio with 10 channels
Four project slots; author says untested on most hardware
